title: Code mockup: With color (daisyUI)
notes:
Code mockup is used to show a block of code in a box that looks like a code editor.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/mockup-code/+page.md
code: can be any color!
